integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the support function of a convex hull and a one-variable minimization. Numerical checks are supplemental only and are not treated as proof or as evidence of originality.
scientific_limitations: The closed minimum-width formula is proved under the condition that the apex projection lies in the base; if it lies outside, only the strict inequality \(w(K)<h\) is claimed. The partial-plank application uses existing Bakaev--Polyanskii machinery once the new altitude criterion is established. An equivalent older width formula may exist in literature not surfaced by the targeted searches.
title: Exact minimum-width formula for convex pyramids and a partial-plank consequence
